title: Annotatio II §.VI: Most Lutherans follow Hunnius; Reformed mostly keep insisting on Augustinian doctrine
pass_a_gloss: For indeed from this time most of the Lutherans followed Hunnius, the Reformed for the most part constantly insisting upon the Augustinian Doctrine.
pass_b_english: From then on the greater part of the Lutherans went with Hunnius, while most of the Reformed held fast to Augustinian teaching on this point.
source_text: Enimverò ab hoc tempore, Hunnium plerique Lutheranorum sequuti sunt, Reformatis utplurimùm Augustinianae Doctrinae constanter insistentibus.

lemmas.note: OCR Augusta-na; sense-normalized to Augustinianae (Predestination context, not AC)

choices.why: OCR Augusta-na in Predestination locus; Reformed keep Augustine's absolute-decree sentence
rejected: Augsburg Confession doctrine as primary sense here

notes: Hexades Annotatio II §.VI densify §191; OCR Augusta-na to Augustinianae (Predestination, not Augustana).
